  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
max_counts AS (
  SELECT wordid, MAX(sense_count) AS sense_count
  FROM synset_counts
  GROUP BY wordid
),
top_synsets AS (
  SELECT sc.wordid, MIN(sc.synsetid) AS synsetid, mc.sense_count
  FROM synset_counts sc
  JOIN max_counts mc
    ON mc.wordid = sc.wordid AND mc.sense_count = sc.sense_count
  GROUP BY sc.wordid
)
SELECT
  w.wordid AS word_id,
  w.word AS word,
  ts.total_synsets,
  ts.total_senses,
  ts.distinct_domains,
  ts.distinct_posids,
  tops.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
  tops.sense_count AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM top_stats ts
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = ts.wordid
JOIN top_synsets tops ON tops.wordid = ts.wordid
ORDER BY
  ts.total_senses DESC,
  ts.total_synsets DESC,
  ts.distinct_domains DESC,
  w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
